fullPassage: Subsidies, taxes, and regulations can all lead to power plants that pollute less by switching away from coal. In all cases, profits can be ① higher from making the transition, even taking the related costs into account. The power plants prefer subsidies over regulations or taxes. The reason is ② obvious. They prefer to receive money from the government rather than pay the costs themselves. But the “expansion” of their opportunity set through subsidies has to be matched by the contraction of the opportunity set of others. The electricity companies' “freedom” is ③ decreased at the expense of the ordinary individual, who must suffer from increased taxation to pay for the subsidy. Moreover, from the perspective of pure efficiency, the subsidy ④ distorts the economy because the electricity company is not facing the full costs of what it does, even if it is successful in limiting emissions. Indeed, electricity prices may end up ⑤ lower than they should be and electricity consumption higher, which will worsen global warming, even though the emissions per unit of electricity have been reduced.

det.analysis: by + 동명사(V-ing) 구조. 'by switching away from coal'(석탄에서 벗어나는 것으로써). switch(동사) → switching(동명사).

questions.passage: Moreover, from the perspective of pure efficiency, the subsidy distorts the economy because the electricity company is not facing the full costs of what it does, even if it is successful in limiting emissions. Indeed, electricity prices may end up lower than they should be and electricity consumption higher, which will worsen global warming, even though the emissions per unit of electricity have been __________ (reduce).
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) 쓰시오. (1단어)

det.korean: reduced (줄어든). 'have been + 과거분사'의 수동태 완료 구조.
det.analysis: have been + p.p. 현재완료 수동태. 배출량이 '줄여진' 대상이므로 수동. reduce(동사) → reduced(과거분사).
det.tip: have been reduced = 줄어들었다 / reduce → reduced(p.p.)

questions.passage: Subsidies, taxes, and regulations can all lead to power plants that pollute less by switching away from coal. In all cases, profits can be  higher from making the transition, even taking the related costs into account. The power plants prefer subsidies over regulations or taxes. The reason is  obvious. They prefer to receive money from the government rather than pay the costs themselves. But the “expansion” of their opportunity set through subsidies has to be matched by the contraction of the opportunity set of others. The electricity companies' “freedom” is  decreased __________ the ordinary individual, who must suffer from increased taxation to pay for the subsidy. Moreover, from the perspective of pure efficiency, the subsidy  distorts the economy because the electricity company is not facing the full costs of what it does, even if it is successful in limiting emissions. Indeed, electricity prices may end up  lower than they should be and electricity consumption higher, which will worsen global warming, even though the emissions per unit of electricity have been reduced.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 전력회사의 자유는 일반 개인의 희생을 대가로(at the expense of) 늘어난다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① at the expense of(~의 희생/대가로): 개인이 세금으로 고통받음과 연결 ←정답
❌ ② in favor of(~에 찬성하여): 문맥 반대
❌ ③ regardless of(~와 상관없이): 문맥 부적합
❌ ④ in spite of(~에도 불구하고): 문맥 부적합

questions.passage: Subsidies, taxes, and regulations can all lead to power plants that pollute less by switching away from coal. In all cases, profits can be  higher from making the transition, even taking the related costs into account. The power plants prefer subsidies over regulations or taxes. The reason is  obvious. They prefer to receive money from the government rather than pay the costs themselves. But the “expansion” of their opportunity set through subsidies has to be matched by the contraction of the opportunity set of others. The electricity companies' “freedom” is  decreased at the expense of the ordinary individual, who must suffer from increased taxation to pay for the subsidy. Moreover, from the perspective of pure efficiency, the subsidy  distorts the economy because the electricity company is not facing the full costs of what it does, even if it is successful in limiting emissions. Indeed, electricity prices may end up  lower than they should be and electricity consumption higher, which will __________, even though the emissions per unit of electricity have been reduced.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 전기 가격이 낮아지고 소비가 늘어나므로 결국 지구 온난화를 악화시킨다(worsen global warming).
det.analysis:
❌ ① lower electricity prices(전기 가격을 낮춘다): 원인이지 결과가 아님
❌ ② reduce total pollution(전체 오염을 줄인다): 소비 증가와 모순
❌ ③ improve air quality(대기질을 개선한다): 문맥 반대
✅ ④ worsen global warming: 소비 증가 → 온난화 악화 ←정답
det.tip: 단위당 배출은 줄어도 소비 증가로 전체 온난화는 악화
